performance_inventory.comment: - Retained from the initial inventory. Verify definitions, flight configuration, and source context before using in calculations.

reported_claims.claim: NotebookLM reports rotor-wake interference as negligible above 60 knots. Confirm the original statement and conditions before using this as a model cutoff.

figure.name: CG_limits
figure.relationship: Permissible gross weight, 8000 to 15000 lb, versus fuselage station, FS 286 to FS 306 in.
figure.finding: Extraction describes gear-retraction forward/aft limits and an achievable CG range around FS 292 to FS 302 in.

figure.name: flaperon_vs_flap
figure.relationship: Flaperon roll-deflection limits versus flap setting, described from -20 deg up to +80 deg down.

figure.name: conversion_corridor
figure.relationship: Nacelle angle 0 to 90 deg versus true airspeed 0 to 320 kt.
figure.finding: Extraction notes about 70 kt at 60 deg tilt as a left-boundary example; reported cruise torque/structural speeds are V_C = 170 kt and V_D = 189 kt.

figure.name: conversion_power_required
figure.relationship: Power required divided by takeoff power available versus airspeed.
figure.finding: Extraction describes a bucket-shaped trend, with a minimum near 80 kt and power ratio around 0.28 at nacelle angles 60 to 75 deg; hover ratio is described as about 0.65.

figure.name: drive_system_frequencies
figure.finding: Extracted frequencies: first asymmetric interconnect-shaft mode 0.39/0.48 per rev; first symmetric power-turbine mode 1.26/1.55 per rev.

reported_figures.comment: - Figure summaries are descriptions from NotebookLM, not digitized data points. Do not turn plotted trends into precise lookup tables without inspecting the original figures.
